PageReaderEnabled.description: Site-wide kill switch. LocalSettings-only; not overridable via MediaWiki:PageReader-config.

PageReaderActions.description: Request actions eligible for the read-aloud module.

PageReaderContentModels.description: Content models eligible for the read-aloud module.

PageReaderNamespaces.description: Namespaces that are always eligible. Default (1004) is Saintapedia's Kids namespace.

PageReaderTitlePrefixes.description: Titles whose prefixed text starts with any of these strings are eligible.

PageReaderPages.description: Titles that exactly equal, or are a subpage of, any of these are eligible.

PageReaderExcludedNamespaces.description: Namespaces excluded even if otherwise eligible. Checked before the allow-lists.

PageReaderExcludedPages.description: Pages excluded even if otherwise eligible (same match rule as PageReaderPages).

PageReaderLoadEverywhere.description: If true, ignore PageReaderNamespaces/TitlePrefixes/Pages and load on every page passing the other gates.

PageReaderContentClass.description: CSS class marking the element to read aloud. An editor can place it anywhere in any article. Default matches the class already used in existing Saintapedia Kids: articles (ported from the prior Common.js implementation) so removing Common.js does not silently make the button stop appearing.

PageReaderContentSelector.description: Fallback CSS selector used when no PageReaderContentClass element is found. Empty = no fallback.

PageReaderSkipSelectors.description: Elements stripped from a clone of the content root before reading textContent. Includes sysop/editor UI (like the patrol link) that lives inside the content area and was only implicitly excluded before the opt-out content-scoping default -- a page with no explicit content marker previously got no button at all, so this chrome was never actually read.

PageReaderVoicePitch.description: SpeechSynthesisUtterance pitch. Web Speech API range is 0-2 (1 is the browser default); values are clamped into range client-side. Higher values sound brighter and less monotone.

PageReaderVoiceRate.description: SpeechSynthesisUtterance rate. Web Speech API range is 0.1-10 (1 is the browser default); values are clamped into range client-side. Slightly below 1 for a calmer, more gentle pace.

PageReaderVoiceGender.description: One of: auto, female, male. female/male select the first available system voice whose name contains that word (case-insensitive); if the device has no such voice, falls back silently to the default voice. auto leaves voice selection untouched (browser default voice). Coverage depends entirely on the browser/OS voice list.

PageReaderHighlightEnabled.description: If true, the article is split into sentences client-side and spoken as a chain of utterances, highlighting the sentence currently playing. If false, the whole article is spoken as a single utterance with no highlighting (this extension's pre-highlighting behavior). Kill switch in case highlighting misbehaves on some browser/device combination.

PageReaderPreferredVoices.description: Per-gender ordered list of voice-name fragments (case-insensitive substring match) checked before the generic female/male name match in PageReaderVoiceGender -- lets a sysop curate known-good voices that don't self-label gender in their name (e.g. macOS 'Samantha', Windows 'Zira'). Empty by default (no behavior change); first entry to match an available voice wins.

PageReaderPiperEnabled.description: Whether the opt-in "Try a better voice" client-side Piper voice option is offered. Overridable via MediaWiki:PageReader-config.

PageReaderConfigPage.description: MediaWiki:-namespace JSON page (requires editinterface to edit) that can override: namespaces, titlePrefixes, pages, excludedNamespaces, excludedPages, loadEverywhere, contentClass, contentSelector, skipSelectors, buttonPlacement, voicePitch, voiceRate, voiceGender, highlightEnabled, preferredVoices, piperEnabled. PageReaderEnabled, PageReaderActions, PageReaderContentModels, and PageReaderIncludeTalk are LocalSettings-only and cannot be overridden here. Empty string disables the overlay.
